$comment: Single machine-readable source of truth for the controlled-merge policy. Consumed by scripts/eif_merge_pr.py (the merge gate) and scripts/tests/test_merge_gate.py. Do not hardcode the required check contexts anywhere else - read them from here. The context names must match the job `name:` values in .github/workflows/ci.yml exactly (that is what GitHub's statusCheckRollup reports). required_check_contexts, allow_no_checks, and knowledge_delta_required are the ONLY switches that can relax enforcement, and only by editing this file - eif_merge_pr.py has no CLI flag that can override any of them. As of D-14 (2026-07-19), routine PR CI is consolidated to this one hosted job; push to main triggers no validation workflow (D-15 records the site-only Pages publication exception). Cross-platform package-build/license-check matrices and the full run_all.py suite inventory moved to the manual .github/workflows/release-check.yml gate.

platform_enforcement.reason: The repository is public. GitHub branch protection on main requires the policy's consolidated PR status context, enforces linear history, resolves conversations before merge, and blocks force-push/deletion. See docs/architecture/merge-enforcement.md.
